name: print-social-church-event-flyer-pair-with-vertical-titles
title: Two event posters with cutout speakers, vertical cream titles and arch shapes
whatItIs: Two side-by-side flyers: one orange-brown, one teal, each with a cut-out preacher, a giant vertical cream title along the edge ('QUINTA profética', 'DOMINGO'), a rounded arch behind the speaker, small name and date text and a crowd silhouette at the base.
whatItMeans: Warm and reverent yet modern; vertical type and arches feel architectural.
techniques: Run huge vertical titles along the poster edge.
Place an arch shape behind the cutout speaker.
Use a warm/cool colourway pair for two events.
Add the crowd photo at the bottom for scale.

vocabulary.definition: Text rotated 90 degrees along an edge.
A rounded-top shape behind a subject.
Two designs in opposite colour temperatures.
A photo of an audience at the bottom.
